name: Micropachycephalosaurus
isnote: Originally described as a pachycephalosaur; later considered a basal marginocephalian or a ceratopsian, the cited analyses disagreeing (Butler and Zhao 2009; Fonseca 2024).
sum: Micropachycephalosaurus is a small, doubtfully placed marginocephalian from the Late Cretaceous of Shandong, China.
wsnote: Likely up to 1 m when fully grown (cited Wikipedia revision).
holotype: IVPP V5542, found on a cliff southwest of Laiyang, Shandong, near Hongtuyan station — Jiangjunding Formation.
material: Holotype only; the parietal and squamosal supposedly belonging to it could not be located by Butler and Zhao in 2009.
author: Dong 1978
